concerns.text: The plan references external game‑difficulty labels (e.g., “Machin et al.”) but does not provide a concrete, verifiable citation (URL, DOI, or repository accession) for the dataset. For the data‑resources lens, every external dataset used in the analysis must be explicitly cited so the upstream resolver can confirm reachability and licensing. Add a formal citation block or inline link for the difficulty‑ranking CSV/JSON.
